title: New Deepal L07 Set for Guangzhou Auto Show: 800V Platform, LiDAR Across the Lineup, Doubao Large Model Brings Voice Out of the Cabin

content_html:
At the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show, which opens on November 27, the new Deepal L07 has confirmed its debut slot. The upgrade strategy for this mid-size sedan is straightforward: an 800V high-voltage platform as the foundation, lidar made standard across the entire lineup, and intelligent driver assistance covering the most frequent travel scenarios—commuting, highway driving, and parking—bringing perception hardware once found only in high-end configurations down to a mid-size sedan’s “factory default.”

On the smart cabin side, the changes are even more refreshing. The new car is equipped with an end-to-end, open-domain Doubao large model and supports voice interaction both inside and outside the vehicle—voice functions are no longer confined to the cabin but extended to more usage scenarios outside the car. Say a single sentence while standing beside the car, and the car can understand and respond. The boundary between the smart cabin and the vehicle body has been quietly blurred by this large model.

For reference, the previously launched 2026 Deepal L07 is positioned as a mid-size sedan, with body dimensions of 4875×1890×1480mm, a wheelbase of 2900mm, and a liftgate trunk capacity of 473L. In terms of design, it retains that highly recognizable combination: split front lights, 19-inch wheels, frameless doors plus flush door handles, and at the rear, an electric retractable spoiler and a liftback tailgate; the range-extender version adopts a concealed exhaust layout. The old model already had a solid foundation, and with the new model adding the three cards of 800V, lidar, and the Doubao large model, this car’s booth at the Guangzhou Auto Show will probably draw quite a crowd of onlookers.
